verdict.rationale: Jan exposes a local OpenAI-compatible API server (localhost:1337) that other applications/agents can connect to as a backend, plus MCP integration for agentic capabilities, supporting the story's core claim. Missing for 10: no independent hands-on verification of an agent actually connecting via this backend, no OpenAPI/spec documentation (probe returned 404s), and no detail on API completeness or auth/config for agent use.
